name: agentforce-optimizer-benchmark
description: A locked 30-question benchmark that scores an Agentforce agent before and after Agent Optimizer changes it, plus a check that your org can call the model Optimizer needs.

scripts.deploy: sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app/main/default/objects --source-dir force-app/main/default/flows --source-dir force-app/main/default/classes --source-dir force-app/main/default/permissionsets
scripts.test:apex: sf apex run test --class-names StoreOrderFlowsTest --result-format human --wait 10

author: Himanshu Palerwal
